runes.name: Fehu
runes.title: Beginning
runes.where: A thought appeared — it wasn't there a minute ago.
runes.what: Write it down. Don't act yet. Let the idea travel further.
runes.feel: A new thought, idea, spark has appeared. It's not clear yet where it leads, but it already exists.
runes.error: Acting immediately without passing through the stages of choice and confirmation.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.title: Multiplicity
runes.where: Your head is spinning with 100 possibilities.
runes.what: Gather data. Don't choose. Just observe.
runes.feel: Your head is a mess. A hundred options, eyes darting everywhere. You're in a whirlwind of possibilities.
runes.error: Trying to choose right now without gathering enough data.

runes.name: Thurisaz
runes.title: Choice
runes.where: You say 'yes' to one thing and 'no' to the rest.
runes.what: Make the choice. Without it you'll be stuck in Uruz.
runes.feel: You say "yes" to one and "no" to the others. You cut away the excess.
runes.error: Fearing to cut options and staying in Uruz.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.title: Confirmation
runes.where: An inner or outer sign: the decision is right.
runes.what: Lock it in. Say out loud: 'Yes, I chose this.'
runes.feel: An inner or outer sign that the decision is right. A "green light".
runes.error: Ignoring the sign, not getting approval from yourself or the world.

runes.name: Raidho
runes.title: First Step
runes.where: Fear is behind you. You've started moving.
runes.what: Take the smallest possible action. Don't wait for the perfect moment.
runes.feel: Fear is behind you. You've started moving. The hardest step is done.
runes.error: Waiting for the perfect moment, postponing the start.

runes.name: Kenaz
runes.title: Manifestation
runes.where: The idea became visible. You can touch it.
runes.what: Show it to the world. Bring it out of the shadows.
runes.feel: The idea became visible. You can touch it. The result has appeared.
runes.error: Not showing the result, keeping it to yourself.
steps: Bring it out of the shadows

runes.name: Gebo
runes.title: Harmony
runes.where: The new and the old have come to terms.
runes.what: Keep your connections. Don't burn bridges.
runes.feel: The new and the old have come to terms. Balance is achieved.
runes.error: Destroying old connections, burning bridges.

runes.name: Wunjo
runes.title: Joy
runes.where: A brief happiness. It's done.
runes.what: Enjoy it. But don't get stuck — Hagalaz is next.
runes.feel: A brief happiness. Done. A completed stage.
runes.error: Getting stuck in the joy, not moving on.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.title: Routine
runes.where: The euphoria has passed. Routine. The car gets dirty.
runes.what: Don't panic. This is normal. Hagalaz is a mirror of quality.
runes.feel: The euphoria has passed. Everyday life has begun. The car gets dirty and needs fuel.
runes.error: Panicking, treating it as a catastrophe.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.title: Signal
runes.where: Something chafes, bothers you. Not a catastrophe yet.
runes.what: Hear it. Don't ignore the small pain.
runes.feel: Something pinches, chafes, worries you. Not a catastrophe yet, but not right either.
runes.error: Ignoring the discomfort.

runes.name: Isa
runes.title: Pause
runes.where: You have stopped. You are thinking.
runes.what: Take a pause. Don't act. Gather your attention.
runes.feel: You have stopped. You're thinking. Not running.
runes.error: Freezing in the pause forever.

runes.name: Jera
runes.title: Insight
runes.where: A flash. 'That's it!'
runes.what: Write the insight down. It won't repeat itself.
runes.feel: A flash. "Exactly!" The solution came on its own.
runes.error: Not writing it down, not using the insight.

runes.name: Perthro
runes.title: Second Chance
runes.where: You're not starting from zero. You use old experience.
runes.what: Don't chase the new. Look at the old with fresh eyes.
runes.feel: You're not at zero. You use old experience for a new result.
runes.error: Starting over from scratch, ignoring experience.
steps: Use the old in a new way

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.title: Experience in Action
runes.where: Fixing an old car in a new way.
runes.what: Use what you already have. Don't mine for new things.
runes.feel: You fix the old car in a new way. You don't buy a new one.
runes.error: Ignoring accumulated experience.

runes.name: Algiz
runes.title: Protection
runes.where: You sense danger in advance. The inner voice.
runes.what: Trust it. Verify it. This is awareness.
runes.feel: You sense danger in advance. The inner voice says "stop".
runes.error: Ignoring the inner voice.

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.title: Victory
runes.where: The cycle is complete. You have become different.
runes.what: Record what you've learned. This is your light.
runes.feel: The cycle is complete. You have become different. The experience stays with you.
runes.error: Not recording the experience.

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.title: Will
runes.energy: will, the beginning of the end
runes.where: You throw the spear at the target.
runes.what: Act without doubt. But only if you have the experience.
runes.feel: You throw the spear at the target. You put all accumulated experience into one movement.
runes.error: Acting without experience.

runes.name: Berkana
runes.title: Growth
runes.where: Something new is growing. A pregnancy, a launch.
runes.what: Don't rush. Growth takes time.
runes.feel: Something new is born from the action. A pregnancy, a product launch, daily care.
runes.error: Rushing, not giving time for growth.

runes.name: Ehwaz
runes.title: The Lift & Bridge
runes.energy: lift, bridge, event transfer to a new level
runes.where: The event is lifted to a new level. Like an elevator taking you to the next floor or a bridge crossing the divide.
runes.what: Use the bridge. Don't leap across by brute force — trust the lift carrying the event forward.
runes.feel: You aren't just walking — the event is transferred to a new level. Like a lift raising you to the next floor.
runes.error: Trying to leap across by brute force, ignoring the lift and bridge.
steps: Transfer the event to a new level

runes.name: Mannaz
runes.title: Confirmation of Rebirth
runes.energy: confirmation of event rebirth, outer validation
runes.where: The event is reborn, and the external world provides definitive validation.
runes.what: Lock in the confirmation. Acknowledge that the rebirth has officially occurred.
runes.feel: The event is reborn, and the world confirms it. What was an intent is now acknowledged reality.
runes.error: Doubting the confirmation, denying that the rebirth took place.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.title: Rebirth
runes.where: The rigid old form dissolves. You enter a deep state of rebirth.
runes.what: Allow the rebirth to unfold. Stop clinging to the past shell.
runes.feel: The old form is gone. You step into rebirth where the past yields to a new essence.
runes.error: Clinging to the old shell, blocking rebirth.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.title: Multiplicity
runes.energy: multiplicity of choices, space for the new, connections & opportunities
runes.where: Space has cleared. A spectrum of possibilities and connections opens up.
runes.what: Explore the multiplicity. Let new connections and opportunities manifest.
runes.feel: Space for the new is created. Before you lies a field of possibilities, fresh connections, and multiple choices.
runes.error: Prematurely narrowing down options, fearing the wealth of opportunities.

runes.name: Othala
runes.title: Connection & Consequence
runes.where: You see the causal chain of the journey: the outcome is a lawful consequence.
runes.what: Acknowledge the consequence. Recognize the link between causes and outcomes.
runes.feel: You see the link of the entire journey: every action was a cause, and the outcome is its lawful consequence and heritage.
runes.error: Breaking the causal link, discarding the hard-won experience.

runes.name: Dagaz
runes.title: Rebirth of the Cycle
runes.where: The old is gone. The new has arrived. The full cycle is reborn.
runes.what: Open the door. Full rebirth is the threshold of a new Fehu.
runes.feel: The cycle is reborn. The new has come. You stand at the threshold of a new level.
runes.error: Fearing the open door, lingering at the threshold.
runes.next: A new Fehu — a new beginning
